nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What substance was tested for its removal potential in the experimental runs?
nodes.answer: DEET was tested for its removal potential in the experimental runs.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Drinking water standards and regulations|Disinfection byproduct regulations_qna_001
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: How many species of halophilic PPB were highlighted as capable of producing three or more chemicals simultaneously?
nodes.answer: The study highlighted 22 species capable of producing three or more chemicals simultaneously.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Drinking water standards and regulations|Disinfection byproduct regulations_qna_002
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: How many chemicals have been estimated as likely POPs according to the Stockholm Convention POP criteria?
nodes.answer: Approximately 590 chemicals are estimated to be likely POPs.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Drinking water standards and regulations|Disinfection byproduct regulations_qna_003
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What types of chemicals have increasingly been produced and used in consumer goods over the past 60 years?
nodes.answer: Brominated, chlorinated, and fluorinated POPs and other PBTs.
